subject.title: Feature: Respect userTimezone in memory file timestamps and naming

question: Should bundled session-memory filenames and `# Session` headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` instead of the gateway host/`TZ` timezone?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it changes shipped memory artifact naming and display semantics for existing users, so automation should not choose the product contract by itself.

options.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
options.body: Treat memory artifact filenames and headers as part of the existing configured-user-timezone contract and update the hook, tests, and docs without adding a new config key.

options.title: Keep host-local session-memory
options.body: Document that the bundled hook follows the gateway host timezone and close or narrow this request to avoid changing existing artifact naming semantics.

options.title: Add a dedicated memory timezone knob
options.body: Introduce a separate memory timezone only if maintainers accept the extra config surface, docs, and upgrade proof burden.

recommendation.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
recommendation.body: Treat memory artifact filenames and headers as part of the existing configured-user-timezone contract and update the hook, tests, and docs without adding a new config key.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the current host-local session-memory behavior and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether that shipped behavior should change.
